result.topic_en: Lecture-style notes on wave motion in liquids: the speed of apparent (wave) motion as the square root of g times length or height, the period of oscillations in a channel, motion of liquids under experimental conditions, efflux velocity and pressure height (square of efflux velocity equals 2g times pressure height), motion in capillary tubes, and air currents and vertical walls.
